rate_limiting.rotating_x_forwarded_for: 65 login attempts with a different X-Forwarded-For each time returned 65 x 401 and 0 x 429
rate_limiting.impact: The only brute-force protection on login/register/forgot-password can be bypassed by spoofing the forwarded client IP because all proxies are trusted and the rate-limit key uses the rewritten RemoteIpAddress.

pii_exposure.observed: A newly created, unrelated teacher account (free plan confirmed, no relationship to the student) received the student's full name, studentId, stage, grade and registration source from a single exact-phone lookup.
pii_exposure.missing_control: No endpoint-specific rate limiting on this endpoint.

headers.cors_evil_origin: no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header on simple request and preflight

token_handling.password_hashing: PBKDF2-SHA256, 120000 iterations, per-user salt, fixed-time comparison
token_handling.refresh_rotation: old refresh token rejected (401) after first refresh; token invalidated on logout (401)
token_handling.reset_token: single-use; clears password reset token and all refresh tokens
token_handling.storage: access and refresh tokens are kept in localStorage (mitigated by strict CSP and absence of HTML injection sinks)

configuration_drift.repo_gitignore: frontend/vercel.json in the working tree still lists connect-src https://emtehani.runasp.net
configuration_drift.risk: A redeploy from this working tree without updating the CSP would block all API calls from the production frontend.
